caption: With the app embed switched on, the storefront preview shows a Rewards panel with Join now. The footer reads Powered by Froonze; the shop name is hidden.
The default earning rule we got without setup: 4 points for every $1.00 spent; the shop name is hidden.
The matching redemption rule: $1.00 off per 100 points, so the default return is 4% of spend; the shop name is hidden.
Paid plans start at $10 a month (Starter), then $24 and $79. Pro is advertised at $99 instead of $149 until Dec 31; the store name and the vendor's staff photos are hidden.
The FAQ on order limits: on the free plan a running program is paused and customers lose access to points above the limit, while a paid plan is upgraded automatically; the store name is hidden.
Approving Starter: a 14 day trial to 1 Dec and a usage spending limit of $199.99 per 30 days, far above the $10 list price; the store name is hidden.
Cancel subscription opens a survey with seven reasons and a greyed out Continue until one is picked. We chose Keep my plan; the store name is hidden.
